title: The Chern classes, the Chern character components and the power sums of a perfect object are multiplied by the sign $(-1)^i$ when one passes to the dual
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the effect of dualizing a perfect object on the Chern classes, the components of the Chern character and the power sums, all acquiring the sign $(-1)^i$ (statement lines 9544-9550). Two arguments are recorded: a reduction to bounded complexes of finite locally free modules of fixed rank together with the dual statement in that case, and a splitting-principle route using the negated Chern roots. The reduction and the transport of the sign through the three families of classes are the substance, so the claim is H2.
